stem: Which quotation from the article shows that the area along the National Road is scenic?

options.label: A
options.text: By 1818 the road was completed to Wheeling, and mail coaches began using the road. (paragraph 2)

options.label: B
options.text: Thousands moved west in covered wagons, and stagecoaches traveled the road, keeping to regular schedules. (paragraph 3)

options.label: C
options.text: Cameras capture old buildings, bridges, and old stone mile markers. (paragraph 4)

options.label: D
options.text: In 1933 a new steel bridge joined the banks of the Casselman River. (paragraph 5)
